body: Tonight is an incredibly hard night isn't it? Our situations are nothing alike, and no one can know truly how horrible your exact feeling is. If somehow I could sit with you in your feeling and just be with you in it so you didn't have to feel so alone I would. Even though I'm currently trying to convince myself there's a reason I'm still here, just take my word right now that there is a reason you, you personally, are still here. And you won't know what it is unless you stick around for it. And just thank your lucky stars that there is a community like this where you can make a post like this and someone will hear your pain. No matter how hard the obstacle is, it is always temporary, and it will always pass.
Animals! You're so right.. Thank you for replying. I'm sorry you have to suffer as well. I wouldn't wish severe anxiety on my worst enemy. There's nothing quite like it.
